apis.d: In this setup, there are three distinct roles involved in the flow of GST data and analytics. The customer is the owner of the GST data and has full control over whether and how that data is shared; no information can move without the customer's explicit, time-bound consent. An Account Aggregator acts as a regulated and secure intermediary whose role is limited to obtaining the customer's consent and securely transferring GST data from source systems; it does not store, analyze, or use the data in any manner. A service provider initiates the request for GST data, receives the consented data via the Account Aggregator, and performs analytics or verification on it to generate insights such as compliance behaviour, turnover trends, or business health indicators.
